annotations.title: Search websites with poor SEO / AEO

description: Search the business websites Triremes measured with gaps in what search engines and AI answer engines can read, each one sold on its own: what kind of business and where, its SEO score and its label, the checks it failed by name, when it was measured, its price, how many times it has been sold and when it last was, and its page. The business, its website and its contacts are bought on that page. One with no SEO score yet is being measured (being_measured): no price, and it can be bought once it has an SEO score.

business.description: A kind of business, such as Dentists or Roofing Contractors; when several kinds match, the answer lists them.

country.description: A country, as its two-letter ISO code (US, DE).

cursor.description: The next_cursor of the answer before, for the next page.

gap.description: Only websites that fail this check, by its id: https (Homepage not on HTTPS), redirects (More than 2 redirects to the homepage), mixed_content (HTTP resources on an HTTPS homepage), ttfb (First byte after more than 1800 ms), title_missing (No homepage title), title_long (Homepage title over 60 characters), title_short (Homepage title under 30 characters), meta_description (No meta description), h1 (No h1 heading), canonical (No canonical link), viewport (No viewport tag), open_graph (No Open Graph title or image), noindex (Homepage marked noindex), robots_blocks_all (robots.txt blocks all crawlers), sitemap (No sitemap), structured_data (No structured data (JSON-LD)), structured_data_invalid (Structured data that is not valid JSON).

gap_score.description: Only websites with an SEO score in this band: catastrophic (Catastrophic: 100%), badly-flawed (Badly flawed: 50% to 99%), flawed (Flawed: 20% to 49%), lightly-flawed (Lightly flawed: 1% to 19%), no-gaps (No gaps: 0%); or in this 10% step: 0 (0%), 1-10 ... 91-100.

max_sold.description: Only websites sold at most this many times; 0 for those never sold.

query.description: Words to find, each somewhere in a website's kind of business, city, region, country or the names of the checks it fails, such as "dentists austin" or "roofing sitemap"; empty for every website.

name: search_website_gaps
